thread:
Maya: quick idea 1 - run a short, focused 'remediation sprintlet' after each postmortem. scope: single remediation ticket, 2-week box, up to 3 owners. keeps momentum and prevents drift. thoughts?
Alex: yes please. can you sketch a tiny timeline + comms?
Maya: sure - draft below (very lightweight):
```
Remediation: one-line summary
Owner(s): @name (max 3)
Target SLA: 14d
Milestones:
 - Day 0: triage + assign
 - Day 2: runbook draft (inc. rollback)
 - Day 5: patch / PoC
 - Day 10: validation + canary plan
 - Day 14: close + short retro
Success criteria: metric delta OR 'no recurrence in 30d'
Recurrence score: 0-5 (>=3 escalate to infra lead)
Validation checklist: synthetic tests, perf baseline, canary window
Stakeholders: list + reviewers
Risks / rollback: short notes
```
Sam: love that. add a field for 'linked signals' so metrics can auto-flag recurrences.
Jen: comms: Day0-3 owner-only 10m in thread (emoji-only updates ok), then M/W 15m check-ins. Weekly digest Friday to #incidents + PMs.
Maya: updated: use status emojis (:white_check_mark: :warning: :hourglass_flowing_sand:). incident-bot will auto-create a sprintlet card when PM tags postmortem "needs-remediation". command: `/create_sprintlet <pm-id>`
Alex: tie to action-tracker please. link: https://tracker.internal/runs/<id>
Maya: plan is incident-bot -> creates tracker issue, assigns tentative owner from oncall at incident time. owners can reassign.
Sam: who is IC for these sprintlets? propose 'remediation lead' defaults to oncall that week; rotates weekly.
Jen: +1. owner SLAs: 48h ack, 7d initial patch or blocker posted; escalate to infra lead if missed.
Maya: agreed. pilot owners: @sam @jen @alex (tentative). I'll run the DB-latency remediation sprintlet starting Monday.
Sam: validation checklist: add automated smoke + perf regression check and a 1h canary window.
Maya: done in template.
Alex: can bot nudge owners 48h before milestone due?
incident-bot: Scheduled reminders created for 48h and 24h before each milestone. use `/reminders` to view.
incident-bot: Sprintlet card created: https://tracker.internal/card/12345
Jen: assigning reviewers: @product-leads @security-ops
Maya: I'll seed the board + one-pager by EOD Friday unless objections.
Alex: no objections.
Sam: go for it.
Jen: :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks all. will post the template to #eng-oncall and seed the first card. will share short retro notes at close.
